Respects max body size limit and truncates or skips oversized pages

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"max_body_size\":1024,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.body_size)
```
